title: G4: RHS / MTTKRP B=TZ must be formed observed-only (avoid O(nMr)=O(M))

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Location:** the RHS $(I_r\otimes K)\,\mathrm{vec}(B)$ with $B=TZ$, $T\in\mathbb R^{n\times M}$.

$B=TZ$ is an MTTKRP; formed densely it is $O(nMr)=O(M)$, which the problem forbids. Since $T$ has only the $q$ observed entries nonzero (others zeroed), $B$ must be assembled from observed triples: $B_{i,:}=\sum_{(i,m)\in\mathrm{obs}}T_{im}Z_{m,:}$, cost $O(qr)$, touching only rows $\tilde Z$. Then $(I_r\otimes K)\mathrm{vec}(B)=\mathrm{vec}(KB)$ in $O(n^2r)$. The attempt must state and justify this; otherwise the 'M-free' claim is false.
